senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.6.7 hīrakam, vajra हीरकम्, वज्र
Diamond
Duly processed hiraka is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-9.1.36 vājīkaraṇam वाजीकरणम्
Potency and fertility therapy
One of the eight clinical branches of Ayurveda concerned with aphrodisiac use.

ITA-1.4.10 vājīkaraṇacikitsā, vṛṣacikitsā वाजीकरणचिकित्सा, वृषचिकित्सा
Fertility treatment
The clinical speciality of Ayurveda dealing with reproductive and sexual health.

ITA-9.9.1 vājīkaraṇacikitsā वाजीकरणचिकित्सा
Aphrodisiac or virility treatment
A treatment for improvement of male and female fertility and virility which promotes śukra secretion
